input._script:
using JSON3, TOML
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    depot = first(Base.DEPOT_PATH)
    pk = joinpath(depot, "packages", "JACC")
    sha131 = "53bc2e5429a60af12cbe4ed9edbe8717b88effc4"
    envdir = dirname(Base.active_project())
    dman = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(envdir, "Manifest.toml")); ddeps = get(dman, "deps", dman)
    out["default_env_jacc_version"] = ddeps["JACC"][1]["version"]
    # other manifests Pkg has seen that still point at JACC 1.3.1
    usage = joinpath(depot, "logs", "manifest_usage.toml")
    refs = String[]; scanned = 0
    if isfile(usage)
        for (mf, _) in TOML.parsefile(usage)
            isfile(mf) || continue
            scanned += 1
            try
                m = TOML.parsefile(mf); d = get(m, "deps", m)
                haskey(d, "JACC") && any(e -> get(e, "git-tree-sha1", "") == sha131, d["JACC"]) && push!(refs, mf)
            catch; end
        end
    end
    out["manifests_scanned"] = scanned; out["other_manifests_using_1_3_1"] = refs
    removed = String[]
    for d in readdir(pk)
        f = joinpath(pk, d, "Project.toml"); isfile(f) || continue
        TOML.parsefile(f)["version"] == "1.3.1" || continue
        d == "6qLvd" || continue
        rm(joinpath(pk, d); recursive = true, force = true); push!(removed, d)
    end
    out["removed"] = removed
    out["jacc_dirs_after"] = Dict(d => TOML.parsefile(joinpath(pk, d, "Project.toml"))["version"] for d in readdir(pk))
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 1500)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
